install_cmds: apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y --no-install-recommends wget && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
pip install scipy clean-fid huggingface-hub safetensors requests filelock lpips

mkdir -p /data/cifar10 && wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=5 --tries=5 -O /data/cifar10/cifar-10-python.tar.gz https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~kriz/cifar-10-python.tar.gz && cd /data/cifar10 && tar xzf cifar-10-python.tar.gz && rm cifar-10-python.tar.gz
python -c "import torchvision.datasets as d; d.CIFAR10('/data/cifar10', train=True, download=False); print('CIFAR-10 OK')"

mkdir -p /data/cleanfid && python -c "from cleanfid.downloads_helper import check_download_inception, check_download_url; check_download_inception('/data/cleanfid'); check_download_url('/data/cleanfid', 'https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~clean-fid/stats/cifar10_clean_train_32.npz')"

data_deps.name: vgg16_lpips_weights
data_deps.description: VGG16 and LPIPS pretrained weights for perceptual loss in VAE training.
